boat_dive.current: Current is not measured at dive depth by any public feed. Within our thresholds up to 0.5 kt; 0.5-1 kt needs descent and trail lines; over 1 kt only with training; 2 kt is beyond anyone's ability to hold position (DAN). 1 kt is about 1.7 ft per second.

posts.excerpt: Vis: 0-10 ft Swell: 2-5+ ft Surface Temp: 70-71 °F High Tide 5.4 ft ~ 10:58 am Low Tide 0.5 ft ~ 6:35 pm The ocean still has some size out there, wave-wise. Visibility is trying to clear up, 0-10ft, but you will find it patchy in most areas with murky conditions in the shallows.

surge.method: Linear wave theory on the nearest buoy's swell and wind waves; peak near-bottom water speed. Fine sand starts moving at about 0.15 m/s (0.5 ft/s).

bottom_line: Shore diving today: outside our thresholds at La Jolla Shores, Point Loma and Sunset Cliffs, and Laguna Beach; marginal at La Jolla Cove. The San Diego County surf forecast is 3 to 5 feet, sets to 6 feet from 200°, with a high rip current risk.

By boat today: outside our thresholds for Catalina and the San Pedro Channel; marginal for the Coronados and the outer islands; within our thresholds for San Diego inshore and the offshore banks. Friday gets worse for San Diego inshore, the Coronados, the offshore banks and the outer islands (steep short-period chop, Santa Ana-pattern offshore wind and NWS advisories).
Nearshore buoys read 71-73°F as of 10:26 AM; the latest satellite temperature map is from Oct 12.
